name: Level Picks
tagline: Honest picks, no hype. Gift ideas, car and garage gear, and deals worth knowing about, checked against the maker's specs.

guides.title: Amazon Black Friday 2026: Start a Prime Free Trial First
guides.intro: Amazon's Black Friday Week runs November 19–30, and some of the deals are for Prime members only. If you're new to Prime, a 30-day free trial covers the whole sale.
what_to_look_for: Check that your account shows "Start your free 30-day trial". If you've had Prime in the last 12 months you may not qualify.
Students and young adults can check Prime for Young Adults, which has its own longer trial.
The trial renews into a paid membership unless you cancel. Set a reminder a few days before it ends.
Make a list before the sale starts so you only buy what you meant to buy.

products.name: Amazon Prime 30-day free trial
products.cta: Start the free trial on Amazon
products.summary: Prime members get access to Prime-only deals during Black Friday Week, plus fast free shipping on eligible items. Eligible new members can try it free for 30 days.
specs: 30-day free trial for eligible new members
Some Black Friday and Cyber Monday deals are Prime-only
Includes Prime Video, Amazon Music and Prime Reading
products.good_for: Anyone planning to shop Amazon's Black Friday Week (Nov 19–30) or Cyber Monday (Nov 30).
products.watch_for: It renews into a paid membership unless you cancel before the trial ends.

guides.title: Audible Free Trial: An Audiobook for the Drive or the Shop
guides.intro: Audible gives new members a 30-day free trial. The Standard plan lets you pick one audiobook a month from the full catalog. Good for long drives, long shifts and the gym.
what_to_look_for: Standard ($8.99/month after the trial) includes one audiobook selection a month.
Premium ($14.95/month after the trial) includes monthly credits; check the sign-up page for current terms.
Both plans renew after 30 days unless you cancel.
The Audible app works offline once a book is downloaded, so it works in a shop or truck with no signal.

products.name: Audible free trial
products.summary: A 30-day free trial for new Audible members. Pick a book, download it, and listen in the truck, at work or at the gym.
specs: Cancel anytime before the trial ends
products.good_for: Commutes, long shifts, road trips and anyone who'd rather listen than read.
products.watch_for: Prices and trial offers change. Check the sign-up page before you start.

guides.title: GTA 6 Launch Gear: Two PS5 Upgrades Worth Grabbing
guides.intro: GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. These two PS5 add-ons fix the most common launch-night problems: weak sound and dead controllers.
what_to_look_for: Make sure accessories say PS5 (or DualSense) compatible.
Wired headsets plug into the DualSense controller's 3.5 mm jack, so there's nothing to pair.
A charging dock is most useful if you own two controllers.

products.name: HyperX Cloud Stinger 2 Core (PlayStation)
products.summary: An entry-level wired headset made for PlayStation, with 40 mm drivers tuned for bass, a swivel-to-mute mic and volume control on the headset.
specs: 40 mm dynamic drivers with neodymium magnets
products.good_for: Anyone gaming through TV speakers who wants better sound and party chat for little money.
products.watch_for: It's wired stereo, not wireless or surround.

products.name: Sony DualSense Charging Station
products.summary: Sony's official dock charges up to two DualSense controllers at once with a click-in design. Sony says they charge as fast as when plugged into the PS5, and it frees up the console's USB ports.
products.good_for: Households with two controllers, or anyone tired of hunting for a cable.

guides.title: Car Emergency Kit: Jump Starter, Tire Inflator and Code Reader
guides.intro: Three things that get you moving again without a second car, a gas station air machine or a trip to the shop just to find out what the check engine light means.
what_to_look_for: Jump starters: match the engine size rating to your vehicle (gas and diesel ratings differ).
Tire inflators: auto shut-off at a set PSI saves you from over-filling.
Code readers: check which systems (ABS, airbag, transmission) it reads for your make.
Recharge battery-powered gear every few months so it's ready in winter.

products.name: NOCO Boost GB40 jump starter
products.summary: A 1,000-amp lithium jump starter for 12-volt batteries, rated for gas engines up to 6.0 liters and diesel engines up to 3.0 liters.
specs: Gas engines up to 6.0 L, diesel up to 3.0 L
Up to 20 jump starts per charge
100-lumen LED flashlight, USB charging for phones
products.good_for: Cars, small trucks, boats and mowers; a backup for cold mornings.
products.watch_for: Big diesel trucks need a larger model. Top it off every few months.

products.name: AstroAI L7 cordless tire inflator
products.summary: A cordless inflator that weighs under a pound. Set the PSI and it stops when it gets there.
specs: Auto shut-off at your set pressure
Modes for car, motorcycle, bike and balls
AstroAI says 30 to 36 PSI on a 195/65R15 tire in about 1.5 minutes
products.good_for: Topping off car, motorcycle and bike tires; glovebox storage.
products.watch_for: Not made for heavy-duty off-road, RV, truck or trailer tires.

products.name: BlueDriver Bluetooth Pro OBDII scan tool
products.search: BlueDriver Bluetooth Pro OBDII Scan Tool
products.summary: Plugs into the OBD2 port and connects to a free phone app. Reads and clears codes and gives vehicle-specific repair reports.
specs: Reads and clears codes, including ABS, airbag and transmission on many vehicles
Vehicle-specific repair reports with possible causes and reported fixes
products.good_for: DIYers who want to know what's wrong before paying a shop.
products.watch_for: Works on gas vehicles 1996 and newer; enhanced-code coverage varies by make.

guides.title: 3 Stocking Stuffers for the Person Who Lives in the Garage
guides.intro: Small, cheap and actually useful. All three fit in a stocking and get used every week.
what_to_look_for: Magnetic tools: check the pull rating if they'll lift heavier parts.
Work lights: rechargeable with a magnetic base is the most useful combination.
Look at the listing's size and weight; small and light wins for stocking stuffers.

products.name: Magnetic wristband
products.summary: A wristband with magnets sewn in. Screws, bolts and bits stay on your wrist instead of rolling off the fender.
specs: Holds screws, nails, bits and small sockets
products.good_for: Mechanics, woodworkers and anyone who drops screws.
products.watch_for: Keep it away from phones, watches and cards with magnetic strips.

products.name: Telescoping magnetic pickup tool
products.summary: Extends to reach the bolt that rolled under the engine or behind the bench.
products.good_for: Engine bays, under benches and tight spaces.
products.watch_for: Only picks up steel and iron, not aluminum, brass or stainless fasteners.

products.name: Rechargeable LED work light with magnetic base
products.search: rechargeable LED work light magnetic base
products.summary: A small rechargeable light that sticks to a hood, fender or toolbox so both hands stay free.
specs: Many have a hook and folding stand
products.good_for: Under-hood work, under-dash work and power outages.
products.watch_for: Battery life and brightness vary a lot between models; check the listing.

guides.title: Thanksgiving Kitchen: A Fast Thermometer and a Skillet That Lasts
guides.intro: The USDA says turkey is safe at 165°F, measured in the thickest part of the breast and the innermost part of the thigh and wing. A fast thermometer takes the guessing out. The skillet is a gift that outlasts everyone at the table.
what_to_look_for: Instant-read thermometers: look at read time, accuracy and whether it's water resistant.
Cast iron: pre-seasoned pans are ready to cook out of the box.
Cast iron is hand-wash only; dry it right away so it doesn't rust.

products.name: ThermoPro TP19H instant-read thermometer
products.summary: An instant-read thermometer with a backlit display that rotates for either hand and a magnetic back for the fridge.
products.good_for: Turkey, steaks, roasts, frying oil and candy.
products.watch_for: ThermoPro is rebranding as TempPro; you may receive either name.

products.name: Lodge 10.25-inch cast iron skillet
products.summary: Lodge's classic skillet, made in the USA and pre-seasoned with vegetable oil.
specs: Stove, oven, grill or campfire; induction compatible
products.good_for: Searing, cornbread, eggs, campfire cooking, and gifts.
products.watch_for: Hand-wash only. Dry it right away and wipe on a thin coat of oil.

guides.title: Gift for Readers: Kindle Paperwhite
guides.intro: For the person who reads before bed. Amazon devices often see their best prices around Cyber Monday (November 30).
what_to_look_for: Paperwhite vs. basic Kindle: the Paperwhite is waterproof and has a bigger screen and longer battery life.
Ad-supported versions show ads on the lock screen; the ad-free version costs more.
Check whether a cover or charger is included in any bundle.

products.name: Kindle Paperwhite (newest model)
products.summary: A 7-inch glare-free e-ink reader with an adjustable warm light, waterproofing and long battery life.
specs: Amazon rates the battery for up to 12 weeks
products.good_for: Bedtime reading, the bathtub, the beach and travel.
products.watch_for: The cheaper version shows lock-screen ads.

guides.title: Auto-Darkening Welding Helmets Worth Buying
guides.intro: You look through your helmet on every weld, grind and cut. Here's a budget hood with a huge window, a premium all-rounder and a digital hood with a separate cut mode.
what_to_look_for: Viewing area: bigger means less tunnel vision, especially out of position. Compare it in square inches.
Optical clarity rating (EN379): four numbers, 1 is best. 1/1/1/1 is the top rating.
Arc sensors: 4 sensors catch the arc more reliably when your hand or the part blocks one.
Shade range and grind mode: a 5-13 or 8-13 weld range plus a grind setting covers MIG, stick, TIG, plasma cutting and grinding.
Battery: a replaceable coin cell with solar assist beats a sealed battery you can't swap.

products.name: YesWelder LYG-M800H
products.summary: A low-cost hood with the biggest listed window of the three and four sensors.
specs: Viewing area: 3.93 x 3.66 in (about 14.4 sq in)
products.good_for: Beginners, garage welders, and anyone who wants a spare hood that still has a big screen.
products.watch_for: It's a budget hood, so expect simpler headgear and fewer settings than the Lincoln or Miller. Check the listing for the exact clarity rating; it varies between versions.

products.name: Lincoln Electric Viking 3350
products.summary: Lincoln's top-of-the-line helmet series, with the top optical clarity rating.
specs: Viewing area: 12.5 sq in (3.74 x 3.34 in)
Replaceable CR2450 battery with solar assist
products.good_for: Daily welders who want top-rated optics, low-amp TIG, and a hood that lasts years.
products.watch_for: It's sold in lots of graphic designs under different part numbers. The lens and specs are the same. The newer 3350 ADV is a different digital model with a slightly smaller window.

products.name: Miller Digital Infinity (ClearLight 4x)
products.search: Miller Digital Infinity ClearLight 4x welding helmet
products.summary: Miller's widescreen hood, with digital controls and a separate mode for plasma and torch cutting.
specs: Digital controls for shade, delay and sensitivity
products.good_for: Welders who also do a lot of plasma or torch cutting, and anyone who wants digital controls.
products.watch_for: It's the priciest of the three. The older ClearLight 2.0 version is discontinued, so make sure the listing says ClearLight 4x.

guides.title: The Best 4-1/2" Corded Angle Grinders for the Shop
guides.intro: In a fab shop the 4-1/2" grinder does the cleanup: mill scale, bevels, weld knock-down and dressing plasma-cut edges. Here's a heavy-duty pick, a slim-grip pick and a budget pick.
what_to_look_for: Amps: more amps means less bogging under load. 6 to 7.5 A is fine for general work; 11 A is heavy-duty.
Switch type: a paddle switch stops the tool when you let go. Slide switches stay on, so be extra careful with them.
Weight and grip size: you'll hold it for hours, so a pound matters.
Spindle thread: 5/8"-11 is standard in the US and fits common wheels and discs.
Guard: a tool-free adjustable guard saves time when you switch between grinding and cutting.

products.name: DeWalt DWE402
products.summary: An 11-amp paddle-switch grinder, the most powerful of the three.
products.good_for: Heavy grinding, beveling plate and running flap discs hard.
products.watch_for: No brake. The DWE402W version adds an abrasive wheel in the box.

products.name: Makita 9557PB
products.summary: A slim, light grinder built with extra dust protection for the motor.
specs: AC/DC switch for generators and other power sources
products.good_for: Long sessions of finish grinding and edge cleanup, where a slim grip matters more than raw power.
products.watch_for: Less power than the DeWalt when you lean on it with a big flap disc.

products.name: Metabo HPT G12SR4
products.summary: An inexpensive grinder that comes ready to work with five wheels and a case.
specs: Includes 5 grinding wheels, side handle, case
products.good_for: A first grinder, a second grinder set up with a wire wheel, or light home-shop work.
products.watch_for: Slide switch stays on if you drop it. 1-year base warranty.
